content: Cross-repo push from GitHub Actions: the default GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to the current repository only and cannot push elsewhere. Classic PAT minimum scope for a PUBLIC destination repository is public_repo (the broader repo scope is only needed for private ones). Fine-grained PAT needs Contents: Read and write plus Metadata: Read, scoped to the destination repository; max expiry 366 days (or none). GitHub auto-deletes classic PATs unused for a year, a common cause of a previously working secret returning 'Bad credentials'.
